messages:
Maria (Partnerships PM): Quick sync — we got final artwork from VertexCloud but there are three asks: logo clearspace, a 2-line co-authorship blurb for the marketplace listing, and legal confirmation on customer quote reuse.
Ashish (Partner Ops): Uploaded the files to the shared folder: https://drive.redwood/partners/vertexcloud/2026-assets :spiral_note_pad: check the 'final' folder. AssetBot: Files uploaded: vertex_logo.svg, vertex_badge.png, vertex_case_v1.pdf
Carmen (Design): I reviewed the SVG. The lockups look fine but Vertex used a shadow in the hero lockup — marketplace rules ban drop shadows within logos. Need a shadowless lockup or alternate. Also want a 1x and 2x PNG with safe padding.
Maria (Partnerships PM): @Carmen can you make the shadowless export and drop a small guidance snippet we can pass to Vertex?
Carmen (Design): Yep. Adding a tiny usage guide in the folder. Snippet: ```Logo placement: left of Redwood lockup, 32px gap. Clearspace = height of the V in Vertex. Do not add effects (drop shadows, glows). Alt text examples: "VertexCloud logo (co-branded with Redwood Inference)".```
Jenna (Marketing): Heads up — for the marketplace thumbnail we need a 16:9 hero with both logos, plus a short tagline. Draft tagline: "High-throughput inference with VertexCloud + Redwood" — ok?
Ashish (Partner Ops): Tagline looks fine. Vertex legal asked for the co-authorship line to state: "In collaboration with VertexCloud" and they want to approve the quote reuse. We need @Oliver sign-off on the permissions wording.
Oliver (Legal): I need the exact quote and which customer it came from. If the quote is public (press release) we can reuse with attribution. If it's from a support ticket or private email, we need explicit opt-in. Upload the quote and consent log.
Maria (Partnerships PM): Quote is from the case study doc (vertex_case_v1.pdf) — it references AcmeCorp and includes a signed release pdf from Acme. I uploaded acme_consent_signed.pdf to the same folder.
Oliver (Legal): Got it. I'll check consent and return a short approval. If consent covers marketing assets and marketplaces, we'll be green. Estimated by EOD.
Carmen (Design): One more thing — the marketplace has a dark UI variant. I made a badge with white logo and one with dark stroke. Added filenames: vertex_badge_light.png, vertex_badge_dark.png. Please confirm which to publish for the tile.
Jenna (Marketing): Use light badge for light backgrounds and dark badge for dark. For the marketplace listing we usually publish both and the marketplace toggles. I'll attach the thumbnail mock: https://figma.redwood/vertex-thumbnail-2026
Ashish (Partner Ops): Vertex asked about alt-text & accessibility. Carmen's alt examples are good, but Vertex wants to provide their own alt text in their localization. Recommend we include a canonical English alt and add a field for partner-localized alt.
Maria (Partnerships PM): Agreed. Carmen, add an "alt_text.md" in the folder with canonical English and a short note for partner localization.
Carmen (Design): Done. Added alt_text.md and updated README with usage rules.
Oliver (Legal): Quick update — consent covers "marketing collateral, case studies, and third-party marketplaces" and includes permission to reuse quotes with attribution. Legal OK as long as attribution text remains. I'll add a one-line legal clause to the README: "Permission granted by AcmeCorp on 2026-06-15 for marketing use; retain attribution."
Maria (Partnerships PM): Perfect. Final checklist: 1) Shadowless logo (Carmen) ✅ 2) Badges for light/dark (Carmen) ✅ 3) Alt text + README (Carmen) ✅ 4) Legal clause added (Oliver) ✅ 5) Tagline + thumbnails (Jenna) working on final 16:9 6) Vertex approval for marketplace copy (Ashish) pending.
Ashish (Partner Ops): I pinged Vertex product marketing to confirm final copy; they said "Approve pending minor copy tweak". I'll post their confirmation here when they sign off.
Jenna (Marketing): When we publish, please use the variant naming convention: `partner-vertex-thumbnail_v1.jpg` and `partner-vertex-lockup_v1.svg` so we can track updates.
Maria (Partnerships PM): Good call. Last ask — include a short attribution line for the marketplace card: "Built with VertexCloud" under Redwood's product bullets. Anyone object?
Oliver (Legal): No objection. Make sure we don't imply joint-ownership or that Vertex endorses Redwood beyond the contractual quote. Keep "Built with VertexCloud" factual.
Carmen (Design): Ok I'll make the final art and export with the agreed filenames. ETA 2 hours.
AssetBot: Reminder scheduled: publish-checklist-review in 24h for partners/vertexcloud/thread/2049123456
Maria (Partnerships PM): Thanks team — syncing back after Carmen's exports and Vertex copy confirmation. :thumbsup:
